prompts.today: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one mobile bottom-navigation icon for Hangul Sori, rendered as a single isolated tactile handcrafted 3D object on genuinely transparent background. Bold instantly recognisable silhouette at only 40px. Front view with very slight 3/4 depth, almost no tilt. Object fills 88-92 percent of square frame; centred, safe 5 percent margin, entire subject visible. Match a coherent set: deep verdigris #247567, muted warm ochre #F5CF78, terracotta, slate blue #5A7BA0, ivory hanji. Strong saturated painted body colours, naturally matte with visible fine grain and worn painted edges, no glossy plastic or glass. Soft upper-left diffuse light, subtle form shading, no cast shadow outside subject, no floor or ground, no white backdrop. Bevelled crisp proportions, simple functional silhouette, generous components easily read when tiny. No labels, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark, no character faces, no ornamental badge behind object. Preserve authentic tactile paper/painted wood/ceramic material rather than clean digital clay. Exactly one standalone icon. Subject: a compact upright tear-off desk calendar. Deep verdigris painted wood frame, thick ivory fibrous paper page, two distinct brass top binding rings, a clear 2-by-3 arrangement of six small ochre date squares. The square calendar shape and top rings must be obvious. No readable numbers. One square can be terracotta to suggest today's date.
